hypothesis: MUR reduces total generated policy+critic tokens by >=40% against per-step Guided Search with accuracy loss <=2pp. This task only implements and validates the smoke gate.
baseline: Stepwise CoT and per-step Guided Search; Qwen3-1.7B BF16 with GenPRM-1.5B. Exact protocol in PROTOCOL.md.
intervention: Bias-corrected EMA alpha=0.9, gamma=0.9; no scaling first step; scale four candidates only when proposal mean NLL exceeds corrected history-log(gamma).
dataset: Pinned HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500 revision in configs/sources.json for eventual full test; prepare 20 held-out development MATH training questions with fixed revision and hashes, excluding normalized test questions.
split: 20 development questions only in this task. Prepare full 500-test manifest but do not generate or tune on test.
primary_metric: Gate validity, then total generated tokens (policy+critic, lower better); pass@1 guardrail. No scientific success claim from smoke.
decision_rule: Pass prep only with source/environment manifests, numerical logprob check, complete token ledger and 20x3 smoke+verification; return timing and 1500-trajectory estimate. Stop before main. If budget prevents full20, retain partial evidence and BLOCKED, not SUCCEEDED.
controls: Read PROTOCOL.md, AGENTS.md, configs/*.json. The user requires REMOTE ONLY and future-public-safe history.

Use one shared GPU index2 only if sufficient observed free memory; at most14GiB new memory, at least4GiB free reserve. Check scheduler; no scheduler found by initial probe. Do not kill or change others' processes.

Reuse existing compatible environments/caches belonging to this user read-only. Inspect flashblock/minicache runtime environments via sibling directories. Never upgrade their packages, modify symlink targets, or copy personal credentials. If new environment needed create isolated runtime environment.
New storage <=20GiB; keep data-volume free >=25GiB; stop otherwise. No unbounded downloads. Pin dependencies and model/dataset commits.

Implement independent, compact vLLM-based runner for three methods sharing prompt/termination/sampling/cost code; main entry python -m mur.run. Add prepare, evaluate and summarize commands and tests. Existing mur.control is a contract, integrate it.

Audit upstream only as reference; no license file detected previously, so do not vendor its code tree. Preserve citation. Inspect installed vLLM API and explicit logprob semantics before implementation.

Backend must provide raw model logprobs for NLL. On remote verify selected-token logprobs against teacher-forced forward for a short output. If sampling transformations differ, fix using supported raw-logprob mode or report blocker. Include cost of any extra scoring calls, not free rescoring.

Prepare sources/download hashes into portable public manifest, store actual paths/URLs with credentials (if any) only in ignored runtime files. Never put host IP, user names, home/data absolute paths or raw logs into tracked outputs.

Keep role-boundary tokens in chat template; first proposal, four fresh candidates, one verification each. Implement Yes/No fallback specified in PROTOCOL.md. Log malformed judgments. Do not silently ignore exceptions.

Commit implementation and configuration BEFORE smoke (run_id in message); run scripts/audit_public.py --staged before every commit. After smoke commit sanitized numeric results. Preserve run SHA separately from HEAD. Every15min active editing checkpoint.
Use deterministic independent request seeds and report execution non-determinism. Bootstrap at question level. Evaluation model loaded after policy/critic are released if necessary.
No API paid model calls other than the authorized DSH session. No full500, no alpha/gamma/seed sweeps, no ablations in this stage.
Long commands foreground inside the managed DSH tool; track job IDs. Do not detach nohup/setsid subprocesses. Wrapper's systemd unit provides final cleanup.

Create report.json and all listed report artifacts in the provided run_dir. Include raw smoke traces there, never Git. Cumulative budget1 GPU-hour within2h wall including model inference and judging; record actual GPU allocation time.
code_revision: Supervisor bootstrap commit at worker startup; executor MUST commit implementation/config before any real model execution and record actual SHA.
environment: Remote RTX3090 CUDA, BF16, compatible vLLM/transformers environment resolved and frozen in environment-lock. Runtime paths from MUR_RUNTIME_ROOT. DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 with existing Node22 adapter verified by supervisor.
experiment_commands: Implement python -m mur.prepare --sources configs/sources.json --runtime-root "$MUR_RUNTIME_ROOT"; commit implementation/config, then prepare exact public models and data.
Implement python -m mur.run --config configs/core.json --split dev --methods cot per_step mur --output-dir "$MUR_RUN_DIR/smoke" with model revisions frozen; commit first.
Implement python -m mur.evaluate --input-dir "$MUR_RUN_DIR/smoke" --output-dir "$MUR_RUN_DIR/evaluation"; commit evaluator before invocation.
Implement python -m mur.summarize to export sanitized numerical evidence and protocol checks.
python3 scripts/audit_public.py --staged; record commit/push status (relay supervisor pushes).

budget.model_cost_limit: No paid inference API. DSH existing subscription only. Smoke <=60 trajectories; <=1 million generated policy+critic+verifier tokens total, <=1 GPU-hour. No full test.
